$comment: Golden conversation for the HelloCamera phone-client conformance kit. Meta-format: docs/conformance/README.md.
title: An acceptance missing the mandatory interaction bundle is schema-invalid

rejection.rule: camera_agent_interaction_v2 is mandatory in every offer and acceptance. The v2 schema requires capabilities to contain camera_agent_interaction_v2. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.1, §4.2; protocol-v2.schema.json protocolAccept)
rejection.effect: The closed v2 object is rejected by the schema; the desktop emits protocol_error_v2 invalid_message or unsupported_capability and wire mode does not switch.

summary: The acceptance selects only generated_visual_guidance_v2 and omits the mandatory camera_agent_interaction_v2 bundle. The closed v2 object fails schema validation.

steps.note: The mandatory camera_agent_interaction_v2 bundle is absent. The schema's contains constraint rejects the object. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.2; protocol-v2.schema.json)

outcome: The malformed acceptance is rejected. Wire mode remains v1; no v2 switch occurs.
